aboutBody: Vinyl Finder is a free search engine for vinyl records sold by independent record shops. It started more than ten years ago as lpepfinder.

Every week our crawler, VinylFinderBot, reads the public product catalogs of record shops, keeps the records in stock, and builds a search index. We link to the shop for every record; we don't sell anything and don't copy product descriptions or images.
Shop owners: your shop is listed for free. To be removed, block VinylFinderBot in robots.txt or contact us; to be added, use the form on the “Add a shop” page.
aboutData: Shop list from the Vinyl Finder community, Discogs record store listings and OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Product data from each shop's public catalog.
submitBody: Any shop with an online store selling records can be listed. Shops on Shopify or WooCommerce get their full catalog searchable; others are listed with a link.
